description: This file defines a React component for a career roadmap page, including UI elements such as a header, a grid of roadmap items categorized into lanes ('Now', 'Near', 'Next'), and interactive status updates for 'Now' items. It includes internal state management and JSX layout.

classes.name: StatusChip
classes.description: A React component that displays a status as a styled chip, with color depending on the status value.

methods.name: StatusChip
methods.description: A React component that displays the status with appropriate styling based on the value.

methods.name: RoadmapStepPage
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the roadmap page, managing state and rendering layout and items.

methods.name: setNowStatus
methods.description: Function to update the status of a roadmap item in the 'Now' lane.
